inputs.text: Common sense and the rule of law finally won out in South Dakota this Thursday, thanks to Governor Larry Rhoden signing Senate Bill 175 into law. It is just basic common decency and respect for our nation that anyone wanting to participate in our elections should have to prove they are actually United States citizens. This is about protecting the integrity of the ballot box, national sovereignty, and ensuring that our sacred civic duties are reserved for those who actually belong to our national family. Of course, the progressive elites and open-border ideologues will likely cry foul, but this measure only applies to state elections and only impacts new registrants. It’s a modest, responsible step toward restoring order and accountability, and every state in the Union should follow South Dakota's lead in putting citizens first.
